Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

PhysioECG 0.4.0

New features

  • ecgHRVasymmetry() — heart-rate asymmetry (HRA) Poincare-plot asymmetry descriptors (Guzik 2006; Piskorski & Guzik 2011): the Guzik/Slope/Area/Porta indices (GI/SI/AI/PI) and the deceleration/acceleration contributions to short-term (C1d/C1a), long-term (C2d/C2a), and total (Cd/Ca) HRV. Quantifies the temporal irreversibility of heart-rate dynamics — decelerations (RR prolongations) and accelerations (shortenings) contribute unequally to variability. Complements the symmetric ecgHRVpoincare() (SD1/SD2). Reproduces NeuroKit2’s hrv_nonlinear HRA indices bit-for-bit (max |diff| ~1e-14).

PhysioECG 0.3.2

Bug fixes

  • ecgDFA() (and the internal .dfa_alpha1() used by ecgDFArolling()) now generate logarithmically-spaced scales instead of linearly-spaced ones. With linear spacing, a long RR series (where n/4 is far larger than 64) left the short-range window [4, 16] with a single scale and the long-range window [16, 64] empty, so the slope fits returned NA — ecgDFA() produced alpha1 = alpha2 = NA on real overnight recordings (thousands of beats) even though it worked on short (a few-hundred-beat) test series. DFA requires log-spaced scales; both windows are now populated and alpha1/alpha2 are computed correctly. Verified on synthetic signals with known exponents (white noise → α ≈ 0.5, random walk → α ≈ 1.5) and against nolds.dfa. Added regression tests covering a long (6000-beat) series and the known exponents.

PhysioECG 0.3.1

Validation

  • Added a real MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database validation test (test-mitbih-validation.R, fixture tests/testthat/fixtures/mitbih-reference.rds, generated by data-raw/ecg_mitbih_reference.{py,R}), replacing the synthetic-RR substitute in the ECG “real data” path (VAL-05). ecgDetectRpeaks() is scored against cardiologist beat annotations (AAMI EC57, +/-150 ms): F1 = 1.0 on the clean record 100 and F1 = 0.97 on the noisiest record 203. ecgHRVtime() reproduces the standard SDNN/RMSSD/pNN50 definitions exactly on a 5-minute real RR series and agrees with RHRV to < 1%.

PhysioECG 0.3.0

  • Added PPG systolic-pulse detection, signal-quality indices, pulse-rate variability, perfusion index, pulse-wave morphology with PTT/PWV, and PPG-derived respiration.
  • Added make_ppg() for reproducible PPG examples with known pulse fiducials.
  • Added RIP calibration, respiratory timing and tidal metrics, and ventilatory-threshold analysis.

PhysioECG 0.2.0

Initial release of PhysioECG as a standalone package in the x-biosignal ecosystem, split out from the PhysioExperiment monolith. Provides electrocardiography (ECG) analysis for PhysioExperiment objects, spanning R-peak detection, heart rate variability (HRV), waveform morphology, and signal-quality assessment.

New Features

  • Multi-detector QRS / R-peak detection via ecgDetectRpeaks(), offering four algorithms behind a common bandpass front end with automatic inverted-lead handling: adaptive Pan-Tompkins (default), Hamilton, Elgendi, and Christov. ecgRRintervals() derives the RR-interval series that feeds every HRV routine.

  • Time-domain HRV via ecgHRVtime() (SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50, mean RR, mean HR), with geometric indices (ecgHRVgeometric(); triangular index and TINN) and long-term segmented indices (ecgHRVsegmented(); SDANN, SDNN index).

  • Frequency-domain HRV via ecgHRVfreq(), estimating VLF/LF/HF band power, LF/HF ratio, normalized units, and in-band peak frequencies from a Welch, Lomb-Scargle, or Burg autoregressive spectrum, with optional smoothness-priors detrending of the resampled tachogram.

  • Nonlinear HRV:

    • ecgHRVpoincare() for Poincare descriptors (SD1, SD2, SD1/SD2).
    • ecgSampleEntropy() for regularity of the RR series.
    • ecgDFA() for detrended fluctuation analysis, plus ecgHRVnonlinear() as a convenience wrapper combining the nonlinear metrics.
    • ecgDFArolling() for a time-resolved DFA alpha1 trajectory and dfaThresholdCrossings() for the Gronwald & Rogers exercise-intensity thresholds (AT1 alpha1 = 0.75, AT2 alpha1 = 0.5).

  • ECG waveform morphology via ecgDelineate() (QRS onset/offset, P- and T-wave peaks per beat) and ecgIntervals(), which reports PR, QT, and QRS durations with rate-corrected QT by Bazett, Fridericia, Framingham, and Hodges formulas.

  • Rhythm gating via ecgDetectAF(), classifying each channel as sinus, atrial fibrillation, or frequent ectopy from RR irregularity (ectopic fraction, RMSSD/mean-RR ratio, and normalized dRR Shannon entropy). The time-, frequency-, and nonlinear-domain HRV functions honor a rhythm_check argument that invalidates HRV metrics for non-sinus channels, where HRV is physiologically undefined.

  • Signal quality and cleaning:

    • ecgSignalQuality() for per-channel SNR, baseline wander, saturation, and a composite quality score.
    • ecgBeatSQI() and ecgBeatSQIgate() for a beat-level quality index from the agreement between two independent QRS detectors.
    • ecgQualityCheck(), ecgRRcorrect(), and ecgEctopicBurden() for ectopic-beat detection, linear or cubic-spline correction, and burden reporting.
    • ecgBaselineCorrect() for baseline-wander removal and smoothnessPriorsDetrend() for detrending a uniformly sampled series.

  • Synthetic ECG generators for examples and testing: make_ecg(), make_ecg_irregular(), make_ecg_pqrst(), and make_ecg_noisy().
